messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Over-the-counter omeprazole is used for:
frequent heartburn that occurs 2 or more days a week in adults 18 years and older
Omeprazole is taken as a 14-day course, once a day for 14 days in a row.
It may take 1 to 4 days to reach its full effect.
Omeprazole is not used for immediate relief of symptoms.
Do not take omeprazole for longer than 14 days.
Do not start another 14-day course within 4 months.
Do this unless your doctor tells you to.
Prescription omeprazole can be used for:
active duodenal ulcer (a sore in the first part of the small intestine) in adults
Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection in adults, taken together with antibiotics, to reduce the risk of a duodenal ulcer coming back
active benign gastric ulcer (a non-cancerous sore in the stomach lining) in adults
symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), such as heartburn, in adults and children 1 year of age and older
erosive esophagitis (EE) caused by acid reflux in adults and children 1 month of age and older
keeping erosive esophagitis healed after treatment, in adults and children 1 year of age and older
Triplet: ["omeprazole", "used for", "frequent heartburn in adults 18 years and older occurring 2 or more days a week"]

The relation 'used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition or symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:

B. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'means drug used in way': The subject term describes the usage of a drug in a manner that is specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
